subject: Acme procurement & security qualification - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Tan <alice.tan@acme-corp.com>, John Lee <john.lee@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-01T15:00:00-08:00
Subject: Acme procurement & security qualification - next steps

Hi Alice / John,

Thanks again for taking the time today - great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep procurement moving: 

- Procurement path: you mentioned AP/PO is preferred for enterprise buys; card works for smaller pilot transactions. Can you confirm which route you plan for Redwood?
- Marketplace vs direct: you said your team is evaluating marketplace options (AWS/Azure marketplace). Please confirm if marketplace purchase would be acceptable from legal/compliance perspective or if you need a vendor contract/PO.
- Security gating: Acme requested SOC 2 evidence and a signed DPA; your security questionnaire will determine a few follow-up items (e.g., encryption-in-transit details, data flow for embeddings).

Attached: Redwood_DPA_v1.pdf (for redline), SOC2_summary_2026.pdf (executive summary), Security_Questionnaire_Answer_Key.xlsx (pre-filled answers to your standard questionnaire).

Proposed next steps: 
1) Please confirm procurement path (PO vs card vs marketplace) and the expected approver for vendor onboarding.
2) If PO, please share vendor form and procurement contact (we can complete vendor setup).
3) If you'd like, we can set up a 30-min call with our security engineer (Dev) to go through the questionnaire. He can also coordinate a secure transfer of SOC 2 artifacts under NDA.

Tentative timeline from our side: once we have confirmation on PO/marketplace and the signed DPA, we can return the completed questionnaire within 2-3 business days and issue a formal quote/DocuSign.

Thanks - looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Alice Tan <alice.tan@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: John Lee <john.lee@acme-corp.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: 2027-03-02T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Acme procurement & security qualification - next steps

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the clear recap. A few answers from our side: 

- Procurement path: For a pilot we typically use a corporate card (up to $25k), but for any multi-month commitment we require a PO through AP. We expect this to be a PO for production.
- Marketplace: We're open to marketplace purchases but need confirmation that the marketplace contract meets our security requirements and DPA terms. If Redwood can accept a PO directly that is easiest for our AP team.
- Security: We need SOC 2 Type II evidence and a completed security questionnaire. We can start procurement in parallel but will need the questionnaire answers completed before approval.

I've attached our vendor onboarding form (Acme_vendor_form.pdf). Please complete the vendor form and return to procurement@acme-corp.com. Also: can you provide an estimated monthly spend range for the pilot so AP can pre-approve?

We can set up a call with your security engineer - Thurs or Fri next week works for our team.

Thanks,
Alice Tan
Procurement Lead
Acme Corp
alice.tan@acme-corp.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Tan <alice.tan@acme-corp.com>, John Lee <john.lee@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: 2027-03-02T11:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Acme procurement & security qualification - next steps

Hi Alice - great, thanks.

We can absolutely accept a PO for production purchases. For the pilot, happy to proceed via card if that makes things faster. Estimated pilot spend (month 1): $8k-$12k depending on usage. We will provide a formal quote if you prefer an exact number for AP.

Actions from our side: 
- Completed vendor form: attached (we filled in the Redwood vendor details).
- DPA: attached Redwood_DPA_v1.pdf - please review and send any redlines. We can also sign your standard DPA if needed; happy to loop legal.
- SOC 2: attached SOC2_summary_2026.pdf. Full SOC 2 Type II report is available under NDA - we can provision that via secure link once a mutual NDA/secure transfer is in place.
- Questionnaire: we've pre-populated answers in Security_Questionnaire_Answer_Key.xlsx to speed this up. Dev (cc'd) can review any technical follow-ups.

Dev - can you confirm availability for a call Thursday 3/4 or Friday 3/5 (PST) to walk through the questionnaire with Alice's team?

I'll also create a HubSpot deal and send a DocuSign link for the DPA so procurement has a trackable workflow. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/123456789. DocuSign (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/example-dpa-sign-link

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Tan <alice.tan@acme-corp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-03T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Acme procurement & security qualification - next steps

Hi Alice / Marissa,

Thanks for the note - I'm Dev (Security Engineer at Redwood). Happy to run through the questionnaire and provide any clarifications. A few quick callouts: 

- SOC 2: we maintain a SOC 2 Type II report covering our production inference service. We can provide a redacted copy via secure link once we have a basic NDA in place; alternatively we can host a controlled review session.
- Data handling: by default we isolate customer data per account, do not persist prompts beyond configured retention, and provide options for customer-managed KMS for encryption-at-rest. I'll point to specific questionnaire sections during the call.
- Timeline: if we get 1) the questionnaire (or the sections you care about) and 2) a short call to clarify a couple of items, we can return a fully completed questionnaire within 2-3 business days.

I'm available Thu 2027-03-04 10:00-12:00 PST or Fri 2027-03-05 09:00-11:00 PST. Please let me know what works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Regards,
Dev Patel
Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com
From: Alice Tan <alice.tan@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: John Lee <john.lee@acme-corp.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: 2027-03-03T10:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Acme procurement & security qualification - next steps

Hi Marissa / Dev,

Thanks - Thurs 3/4 at 10:30am PST works for us. Please send a calendar invite and we will have our security/IT procurement representative (John) join.

Procurement note: we'll start the vendor onboarding in parallel; AP has requested a formal quote and the completed vendor form (attached). Please send a DocuSign DPA and a formal quote for the pilot so I can move this through AP.

Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Alice
